7/1/2011 Wedding

JAMMIN’ DJ’s light it up Mile High Station in downtown Denver for the Siegrist- Montoya wedding. It was one amazing night complete with fireworks and plenty of spirits. Radke and Bryan rocked the house all night long as the crowd was getting down to the Dougie. With Georgia Best DJ Service there’s always a night to remember.

~Jason Radke~
